spell.wizardry_restored.lightning_bolt.d: Calls a bolt of lightning down on the spot you are pointing at. Needs open sky.
spell.wizardry_restored.sixth_sense.desc: Reveals every creature around you, even through walls, for a short while.
spell.wizardry_restored.shockwave.desc: Unleashes a blast of force that hurls everything around you away.
spell.wizardry_restored.snowball.desc: Throws a snowball where you point.
spell.wizardry_restored.mine.desc: Breaks the block you are looking at. More potency breaks harder blocks.
spell.wizardry_restored.mind_trick.desc: Confuses the target: it forgets whom it was fighting and grows weak.
spell.wizardry_restored.blink.desc: Instantly teleports you a short distance to where you point.
spell.wizardry_restored.intimidate.desc: A terrifying growl makes nearby creatures drop their target and flee.
spell.wizardry_restored.glide.desc: Hold to glide forward instead of falling.
spell.wizardry_restored.ironflesh.desc: Your skin turns to iron: much tougher, but slower.
spell.wizardry_restored.diamondflesh.des: Your skin turns to diamond: almost nothing gets through.
spell.wizardry_restored.greater_fireball: Launches a large fireball that explodes on impact.
Lightning strikes the target and jumps to nearby enemies, twice.
spell.wizardry_restored.paralysis.desc: A bolt that paralyses the target for a few seconds.
spell.wizardry_restored.summon_iron_gole: Summons an iron golem to fight for you for a while.
spell.wizardry_restored.lightning_ray.de: A continuous stream of lightning that keeps damaging the target.
spell.wizardry_restored.disintegration.d: A bolt of flame; slain targets burst into burning embers.
spell.wizardry_restored.transience.desc: For a while you are invisible and immune to damage, but can barely harm anything.
spell.wizardry_restored.mind_control.des: The target switches sides and fights for you for 30 seconds. Does not work on bosses.
spell.wizardry_restored.metamorphosis.de: Turns a creature into a kindred form (cow to mooshroom, zombie to husk...).
spell.wizardry_restored.frost_barrier.de: Raises a wall of ice in front of you for 20 seconds.
spell.wizardry_restored.wall_of_frost.de: Hold to grow ice wherever you point. It melts after a while.
spell.wizardry_restored.thunderstorm.des: Calls down a storm of lightning on enemies all around, arcing between them.
spell.wizardry_restored.earthquake.desc: The ground heaves: creatures around you are thrown up, hurt and stunned.
A pillar of holy light strikes where you point. Undead take double damage.
spell.wizardry_restored.slow_time.desc: Enemies around you nearly freeze in time; their projectiles slow down.
spell.wizardry_restored.light.desc: Creates a magical light for 30 seconds.
spell.wizardry_restored.shadow_ward.desc: Hold to raise a ward of darkness that returns half of incoming damage to the attacker.
spell.wizardry_restored.ice_shroud.desc: For 30 seconds anything that strikes you is gripped by frost.
spell.wizardry_restored.summon_spirit_wo: Summons a spirit wolf that fights at your side until slain.
spell.wizardry_restored.summon_spirit_ho: Summons a fast spirit horse to ride. It fades if left without a rider.
For a while your melee strikes freeze your foes.
spell.wizardry_restored.empowering_prese: You and nearby allies cast stronger spells for a while.
spell.wizardry_restored.muffle.desc: For 30 seconds creatures farther than a few blocks do not notice you.
spell.wizardry_restored.grapple.desc: A magical vine pulls a creature to you, or pulls you to a block.
spell.wizardry_restored.transportation.d: Sneak-cast to remember this place; cast normally to return to it (same dimension).
spell.wizardry_restored.ice_statue.desc: Encases the target in ice for 20 seconds.
spell.wizardry_restored.petrify.desc: Turns the target to stone for a long while. Does not work on bosses.
spell.wizardry_restored.transportation.o: The remembered place is in another dimension
Charges the ground around the caster with lightning, damaging and repelling nearby creatures.
spell.wizardry_restored.conjure_armor.de: Creates spectral armor around the caster which offers protection equal to that of iron armor. The armor lasts for 60 seconds. The caster must have an empty armor slot.
